label: Sage Companies
description: The Sage company of each Sage number, in the same order (an online sale can post to several).

label: Post Each Item to Its Own Company
description: Online: each item sells from its own company's warehouse and posts to Sage in that company (one Sage invoice per company, on the company's online customer and rep). No stock transfer, no intercompany.

label: Online Customer ID (Sage)
description: The Sage customer an online sale of this company's items posts to (till ticked Post Each Item to Its Own Company).

label: Online Sales Rep ID (Sage)
description: This company's Sage rep for online sales. Sage refuses a credit note without one.
